# Leonardo values for PowerPoint

Use these values to build the PowerPoint template. Values marked *proposal* are not final yet.

## Theme colors

| Color | Light | Dark | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accent` | #1B6CE0 | #7FB2F0 |  |
| `onAccent` | #FFFFFF | #0A1A33 |  |
| `link` | #0B4A99 | #A9CCF6 | 9.8:1 on surface. |
| `selection` | #DCEAFB | #1E3A66 | Selected rows and items. Text on selection stays textPrimary; the accent is only used as a non-text indicator here (4.0:1). |
| `surface` | #FAFBFD | #1A2030 | Opaque content surface, cool neutral. |
| `surfaceAlt` | #F3F7FC | #141926 |  |
| `textPrimary` | #141B2B | #EEF2F8 | 16.6:1 on surface. |
| `textSecondary` | #4A5568 | #B3BDCC | 7.3:1 on surface. |
| `textTertiary` | #5E6878 | #A3AEC0 | Metadata. 5.4:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on selection. |
| `strokeSubtle` | #DFE5EE | #2C3547 | Decorative separators only. Not for boundaries that carry meaning. |
| `strokeStrong` | #78849A | #6E7A8F | Boundaries of interactive elements. 3.6:1 on surface. |
| `chart` | #0B4A99 | #7FB2F0 | Data series in charts, the one blue of a single-series chart. 8.3:1 on surface. In contrast themes, the system highlight color. |
| `statusCritical` | #C42B1C | #FF99A4 | Mirrors the Windows Fluent status color. Native apps use their platform's status colors; only standalone web and presentations use this token. |
| `statusCaution` | #9D5D00 | #FCE100 | Mirrors the Windows Fluent status color. Native apps use their platform's status colors; only standalone web and presentations use this token. |
| `statusSuccess` | #0F7B0F | #6CCB5F | Mirrors the Windows Fluent status color. Native apps use their platform's status colors; only standalone web and presentations use this token. |

## Blue scale

Charts use the blue scale.

| Color | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `depth` | #0A1A33 | Dark surfaces, text. 17.4:1 on white. |
| `near` | #0B4A99 | Links and blue text. 8.6:1 on white. |
| `brand` | #1B6CE0 | Logo, accent, buttons. 4.9:1 on white; white text on brand is 4.9:1. |
| `far` | #7FB2F0 | Lines, charts, accent on dark ground. 7.9:1 on depth. |
| `haze` | #DCEAFB | Selection, surfaces. Surface only, NEVER text. |
| `sky` | #F3F7FC | Background. Surface only, NEVER text. |
| `white` | #FFFFFF |  |

## Fonts

| Role | Typeface | Size | Weight |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placeName` | Inter Display | 40 pt | Light (300) |
| `view` | Not used in presentations | – | – |
| `section` | Inter | 24 pt | Semibold (600) |
| `body` | Inter | 18 pt | Regular (400) |
| `meta` | Inter | 12 pt | Regular (400) |

## Durations

| Motion | Duration | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enter` | 0.3 s | Smooth end fully applied. |
| `exit` | 0.2 s | Smooth start fully applied, with fade. |
| `morph` | 0.5 s |  |
| `fade` | 0.1 s |  |
| `staggerStep` | 0.05 s |  |
